bAri bArigE pAthivrathyava bhOdhisE jArEgadhara nija sOgasIthE

charaNam 2 - pattEmancha thiruvittarE phaNEyOLu mEttidha bhramaNEyu bittIthE
bEttadha nalivigE kaNNEru bandharE bEtEgAragE dhaya puttIthE kEtta
hAvu kaCHidha gAyakE haLE battEyOlOrasE visha hOdhIthE
dhanikara kanDu dhainyava paTTarE - dhAridhryavu hingIthE
dhina dhina sOsalOLu thirumaNiyiTTarE - dhEvara dhayavu puTTIthE
